description.zh: 龍洞是台灣最具代表性的戶外攀岩場地，位於新北市貢寮區，擁有壯觀的海岸岩壁和多樣化的攀登路線。是台灣規模最大、路線最多的天然岩場。
description.text: Long Dong is Taiwan's most iconic outdoor climbing destination, located in Gongliao District, New Taipei City. It features spectacular coastal cliffs and diverse climbing routes, making it the largest natural crag in Taiwan with the most routes.
